holderQuote: As the Armored Queen ordered her busy Prognugators to help her manage her busy Hive, Anand explained his [Strategist] class. And level.
But first…Anand wanted something. The [Strike Strategist] knew few things in this world. But he knew this.
Anand, known to some as ‘Anand the [Strategist]’, was a [Strike Strategist]. An expert in rapid attacks and retreats.
Anand was a [Strike Strategist], not a hero.
